findings.text: Requirement 2 ("grow live", no jump when the final text replaces the guess) has no proof: the walkthrough and screens show only finished messages, and no test or shot shows a pill widening while words arrive.

V2 at 1920 draws the reply "Hello! What would you like to work on?" indented about 200px right of every other reply (icon at x=523 vs 321) — layout (alignment), screens/v2-1920.png, band 3. V3 has no such indent.

shots/ is empty and its layout.json is missing (session.jsonl logged widths 400/1200/1920/3440, `bands: []`), so nothing is measured; the review judged the builder's screens/ instead. The walkthrough also says the shots came from 127.0.0.1:62509, not monorepo.lew42.com as asked (req 5).
`ux/Dictate/readme.md` is stale: `Widget.css` changed and now sets `--bubble-max` for the Dictate bubbles, but the readme never mentions `ext/Chat/bubbles.css` or the shared token.

The assistant's text wraps well short of the 80% cap: at 1920 V2/V3 replies wrap at about 400-500px while the owner pill reaches 500px+ (screens/v2-1920.png, V3 "Compacted..." wraps at ~800px of 940). The two sides read as different max widths.
V2 shows a faded, right-aligned preview ("I would like the chat to look more...") directly above the long pill, a second copy of the same words (screens/v2-360.png, v2-1920.png).

No chat-layout/readme.md, and `past-work.md` and `screens/` are not linked from the walkthrough or the session record. A fresh agent can continue from `requirements.md` + `walkthrough.md` + the diff, but not from an index.
